shares.source: Systems' exact asserts for the materials on #139 (comment 6203159815; the per-tier bound is 650 bp on every planet since 6203640346) with the trip asserts of 6202970624 section 7.5 and the family-first share of ticket 446 (6226198316): ticket 449. Shares are whole basis points, rounded up, from the trip ledger over the pacing seeds. A missed bound is a balance finding; no bound moves to pass. The deep rows (ticket 738, Bjor's deep-rares rule) move rare value out of band 2 into bands 3 to 5 by design: the named #644 re-baseline 'deep rares' waives the per-band mean on them (Systems' guard on #738), and their mean is held on the whole planet instead, within the VS's 5% of main (VS on #737/#738).
